basic_info.description: Expansive, updated, two-level house-like condominium in a prime Mission-Noe-Valencia location, designed for modern live-work lifestyles. The upper level offers classic SF charm with hardwood inlaid floors, coved ceilings, French doors, a full-width living room with fireplace, formal dining room, and remodeled kitchen with Carrera marble countertops, stainless steel appliances, and breakfast nook. Two spacious bedrooms include a primary suite with full bath, plus a second hall bath and a sunroom with access to a private deck, perfect for an office or nursery. The dramatic lower level features soaring ceilings, a second full kitchen, open living area, and two additional en-suite bedrooms. Floor-to-ceiling fold-flat glass doors open to a private walk-out deck and garden, creating seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Ideal for multigenerational living, guest quarters, or dedicated creative space. Includes in-unit laundry, updated systems, and garage parking. Walk Score 97, close to shops, transit, and top dining.
